catalogRegistration.role: coordinate-registration audit; photograph owns visible stars

pointSourcePresentation.positionSource: licensed ESO photographic local maxima; no Google catalogue bytes
pointSourcePresentation.qualification: native fixed-size catalogue behavior collapsed into the prepared cubemap; point positions and colors remain ESO-derived

sky.qualification: source-photographed full sky; orientation is registered to Galactic coordinates but no observer epoch or Saturn ephemeris is claimed; no Sun is baked into the cubemap

analyticRadialFit.qualification: Least-squares fit to annular red-channel means from the bound native 128 by 128 Sun texture; fitted values only, no source pixels.

distanceScaling.qualification: The opaque photospheric core is projected from the IAU nominal solar radius and the object catalog's mean heliocentric distance. The retained glow profile remains a visual presentation; the distance is not epoch-specific.

provenance.source: Google Earth Pro Mars native Sun contract-derived visual standard
provenance.qualification: Mars-derived clean-room Sun appearance and camera-relative motion are shared as a cssEarth presentation standard; no per-object native Sun position or ephemeris is claimed.

controls.label: Visible color
controls.description: Visible-light appearance from the prepared OpenSpace Saturn mosaic. This is a presentation texture assembled from observations, not a live image of the scene date.
controls.title: Visible-light mosaic
controls.summary: Cloud bands are assembled from archival visible-light observations. The mosaic does not depict conditions at the scene date.

controls.label: Ultraviolet
controls.description: Hubble OPAL F225W (225 nm), August 2025, shown in false color. Broad ultraviolet structure is measured; missing polar/ring-occluded rows are filled along longitude and fine detail comes from a bounded visible-light transfer. This composite is not pure ultraviolet imagery.
controls.title: OPAL F225W map
controls.summary: The 225 nm observations date to August 2025. Filled rows and added visible-light detail are not ultraviolet measurements.

controls.label: Methane
controls.description: Hubble OPAL FQ889N (889 nm), August 2025, shown in false color. This methane-absorption band traces atmospheric structure, not a methane concentration map. Missing rows and fine visible-light detail are filled as described for ultraviolet.
controls.title: OPAL FQ889N map
controls.summary: The 889 nm observations include filled rows and added visible detail. Brightness does not measure methane concentration.

controls.label: Thermal illustration
controls.description: Schematic illustration from visible-light morphology and authored patterns. Colors do not measure infrared brightness or temperature; this is not a Cassini observation.
controls.title: Thermal-style cloud illustration
controls.summary: Visible cloud patterns are recolored to suggest a thermal view. The colors do not measure temperature or infrared brightness.

controls.label: Cross section
controls.description: Schematic interior layers based on models of Saturn. Boundaries, colors and exposed structure illustrate inferred composition; they are not photographs or a measured interior map.
controls.title: Interior structure model
controls.summary: Colored layers distinguish the inferred interior structure. Their boundaries illustrate a model, not a measured interior map.
